messages:
Mia: FYI incoming escalation from AcmeCorp. Customer called refund endpoint but our autorouter invoked update_invoice instead. They got 200 and a changed invoice, not a refund. /cc @Dan, @Aisha :grimacing:

Aisha: Ack. Can you paste their request payload and any headers?

Mia: Pasting sanitized payload:
```
POST /v1/actions HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  \"intent\": \"refund\", 
  \"amount\": \"0.00\",       // note: string
  \"currency\": null,           // missing null
  \"customer_id\": \"cus_12345\"
}
```
They said they used the web UI which calls the same endpoint.

Dan: Interesting — amount as a string + null currency could trip schema validation. Our tool resolver prefers exact signature match, then falls back to fuzzy scoring if validation fails. Might have treated amount as missing number and matched update_invoice which accepts optional amount/string.

Jordan: router-bot logs show fuzzy scores for that request at 2026-04-10T14:12:03Z:
```
candidates: [
  {name: \"update_invoice\", score: 0.76},
  {name: \"refund\", score: 0.71}
]
chosen: update_invoice (priority tie-break: legacy_priority)
```
So it was close. :thinking_face:

Sarah: Can we get the full router debug trace and the validation errors? If we can repro locally that helps.

Dan: Repro steps I used (worked locally):
1) curl with same payload (amount string + null currency)
2) enable RT_DEBUG=1
3) watch /var/log/router/debug.log
Curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/actions \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{\"intent\":\"refund\",\"amount\":\"0.00\",\"currency\":null,\"customer_id\":\"cus_12345\"}'
```
Observed resolver behavior in debug.log: `validator: amount type mismatch -> treating as absent; signature_match: update_invoice wins on optional_amount rule`.

Aisha: Customer impact: they lost a $0.00 credit applied to invoice. Not huge but trust issue. They want a fix and either a rollback or explicit guidance on how to call to ensure refund.

Mia: They tried adding \"intent\": \"refund\" explicitly and still got invoice update. They expect explicit intent to force tool.

Dan: That's a bug — explicit intent should override fuzzy. I think legacy_priority logic currently has a bug when validator reports field-as-absent; explicit intent gets demoted. I'll open a quick patch: if explicit intent present, require exact name match in resolver before scoring.

Jordan: For immediate mitigation, advise customer to ensure amount is numeric and currency present, or include `tool_override: \"refund\"` in payload. Example:
```
{\"intent\":\"refund\",\"amount\":0.0,\"currency\":\"USD\",\"tool_override\":\"refund\"}
```
That bypasses resolver.

Sarah: I'll grab logs for that timeframe:
router-bot: [2026-04-10T14:12:03Z] TRACE router.request id=req_9b2f validator.amount: type=string -> error(type_mismatch) validator.currency: null -> treated_as_absent
router-bot: [2026-04-10T14:12:03Z] TRACE resolver.candidates update_invoice(0.76), refund(0.71) chosen=update_invoice (legacy_priority)

Dan: Created GH PR #4827 with tests reproducing string-number mismatch and explicit intent case. Quick fix to be cherry-picked to stable. Leaving note: patch flips tie-break to prefer explicit-intent exact match.

Aisha: Great — timeline for patch to prod?

Dan: Can ship a hotfix to staging within 90m, smoke test, then rollout to prod (canary) next 2hrs if no regressions. Will also add telemetry to catch future amount-as-string calls and surface to support.

Mia: I'll message the customer with workaround + ETA. Draft: \"Hi — we found the cause: amount was passed as a string and currency was missing. As a workaround, please send amount as a number and currency=USD or add tool_override=\"refund\". We're deploying a fix in ~2 hours and will follow up.\" :+1:

Jordan: Also recommend adding server-side validation docs snippet in support KB so customers don't accidentally send amounts as strings.

Mia: Filing a KB task. Thanks all.

Dan: Follow-up action items:
- [Dan] hotfix PR -> staging (in progress)
- [Sarah] collect paired logs for affected customers
- [Aisha] notify customer + include workaround
- [Jordan] add KB snippet + add telemetry alert
- [Mia] close ticket after patch verified

Aisha: marking ticket P2 -> resolved once patch deployed. :white_check_mark:

Mia: Closing loop here, will post final once prod rollout complete.
